text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I haven't gotten the chance to speak with
Admire Vega since her
tryout race, and it's
been gnawing away at me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what hounds her as she runs,
what lies in the chasm she
always seems to
be peering into, or what burden weighs
her down...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus looking for
her, I spot her training
partner from the
other day, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh... Um, y-you want to know if I've seen Ayabe? Uhh, well... I-I guess I have seen her, but...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! If it is our disciple of the
stars whom you seek, look
to the lofty
peaks! Even now she proffers herself to the
treacherous
slopes!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In plebeian terms, yes! Or to really break it
down, "She's gone for
some trail running!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm! I-I know I don't belong in your
conversation, b-but if you know
where she
is, you'll head there right away, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Ayabe has no problem whatsoever
doing very high-level training...
and that's
probably what she's doing now, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-so please don't go! The trails are way
too dangerous for a regular
person...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let him go, Doto. For inside his head,
already the bells of fate toll
their song.
There is no stopping him.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let her go, Doto. For inside her head,
already the bells of fate toll
their song.
There is no stopping her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a hearty laugh, she tells me more
precisely where I might find
Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wah, n-no turning back now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe kept insisting on being alone ever
since tryouts... Do you think
she'll be
okay?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Some hold their ear to the door. Some
brave a knock. And yet others
kick it
down. I say let it be!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You came to speak with me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing to say. And I'm not
accepting any scouting offers right
now,
so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, that didn't last long. But I'm here
with a goal, and I'm going to
see it
through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto did warn me, to be fair, but this trail is no joke! The gap between us widens and widens.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it only gets worse...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I soldier on despite having lost sight of
her, the sun sinks far below
the treetops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tumble, crash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My senses gradually return, and I ease
open my eyes to find... stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sea of stars so vast I feel as if I might
drown.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one asking the questions. Are you
hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, not like I could just leave you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a long sigh, Admire Vega lets slip a
question.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why do you care about me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My tryout race was... You saw what
happened. I don't know you, and
you
barely know me either.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... why?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine being alone. Prefer it, even.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Running, winning... These duties I must
bear alone. Because she... my
sister, she...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She gave her life in my stead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I've said too much. Forget that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So that's the burden she carries. No doubt
there's more to it, but one
thing is
clear—she's determined to bear it alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My legs are killing me. It's a miracle my
body can still move. But I'm
here now, just
within reach.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You really don't learn. Now what?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's curfew, so... I should go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ayabe! Welcome back. ♪ Hey, check
out this super fluffy—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but... I just want to sleep right now.
I'm so... tired...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, um, oookay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aw, look at Sleeping Cutie over here. Well, well, well... somebody had an extra-nice day.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream. And for the first time in
forever... it was a pleasant
dream.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was with her, the most adorable sister I've
never seen, running
through a sea of stars,
not a care in the world...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I hear a timid knock at my
door and open it to find...
Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'll need a trainer to compete in
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So if I have to choose, then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It might as well be you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem particularly excited to
have me, but, well, it's a
start.
